# @stackline/brace

Maintained Brace-compatible packaging for Ace Editor {{ACE_VERSION}}.

Install directly:

`npm install @stackline/brace`

Install as a drop-in replacement:

`npm install brace@npm:@stackline/brace@^{{PACKAGE_VERSION}}`

The package preserves Brace deep imports, supports CommonJS and an ESM root, embeds browser workers, supports TypeScript 3.9, and has zero runtime dependencies.

Canonical documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/brace/
Source: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-brace
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stackline/brace
